lines.1: 「I'd like to go check on her, but Kiriya Company is swamped all week. Today and tomorrow are especially important.」
lines.2: 「...Wait. From the way things have been lately, Yoppi seems to like you, Tsushima-kun, and you're responsible enough to trust with this.」
lines.3: 「Actually, you're kind of the only one I can ask, aren't you?」
lines.5: 「Would you go to Yoppi's place for me and see how she's doing?」
lines.7: 「Yeah. And could you give Yoppi a message for me?」
lines.8: 「You only have to pass it along. You don't even need to see her face-to-face.」
lines.10: 「You can just order me around like usual.」
lines.11: 「Mm. Not for this. This one's a favor.」
lines.12: The Princess got downright humble when Yoshimi was involved.
lines.14: Besides, this might be because of what happened yesterday.
lines.15: 「She told me where she lives the other day, too.」
lines.16: 「You even know that? If Yoppi trusts you that much, you're an even better choice than I thought.」
lines.17: 「And if she really is sick, I'll cancel the family stuff starting tomorrow and go see her myself.」
lines.18: 「Princess, you don't have to worry that much.」
lines.19: 「Mm... But whenever I email or call, she always gets back to me. That's why this bothers me.」
lines.20: 「Maybe she's just asleep. I'll go check on her, anyway.」
lines.21: 「I know I'm repeating myself, but you don't have to go inside. Just ask how she's doing over the intercom.」
lines.22: 「Yeah. If she's sick, I don't want to make her push herself.」
lines.24: The Princess left the classroom, her ponytail swaying behind her.
lines.26: 「Oh... right. Here, my cell number. If you get there and there's some kind of emergency, call me.」
lines.27: 「Got it. And I keep your number secret from everyone else.」
lines.28: 「Obviously. I don't hand it out that easily.」
lines.29: The Princess collected herself and left the classroom again.
lines.31: 「If Yoppi mentions me, tell her I don't care how--I just want to hear her voice as soon as possible.」
lines.33: This time the Princess finally left the classroom for good.
lines.34: Princess... you really do love Yoshimi.
lines.35: All right. I'll make sure I check on her properly too.
lines.36: And then there was what happened yesterday.
lines.37: Yoshimi's so innocent that maybe she's too embarrassed about that to come to school.
lines.38: I was embarrassed about facing her too, after all.
lines.39: If that's the reason, I need to make sure I smooth things over.
lines.40: Yoshimi's pure-hearted. I need to be gentle with her.
